discovery_outcomes.subject: target_user
discovery_outcomes.target_segment_or_system: the configured technical owner using the supported single workspace and single team
discovery_outcomes.expected_change: complete the bounded project, milestone, and issue workflow on a self-hosted release without facilitation or a critical error

metric.name: core workflow completion rate
metric.definition: share of ten independently reset canonical runs completing local-runtime entry, project and milestone planning, issue execution, saved view, context-preserving detail edit, and persisted readback
metric.workload: ten independently reset canonical seeded core workflow runs

measurement.method: instrumented owner workflow runs with fixed task definitions, independent seed resets, and synthetic data
measurement.source: versioned owner-run observation records and application audit evidence

guardrails.name: unauthorized local data access count
guardrails.metric_definition: count of confirmed events where a remote listener, hostile browser origin, or unsafe local path exposes or mutates product data
guardrails.source: local-origin, listener, filesystem, import security tests and confirmed incident records

invalidation_threshold.metric_definition: core workflow completion rate after two bounded remediation rounds

assumptions: CT-77's statistical ranking keeps the canonical workflow migration-critical across supported project types
the supported one-process local runtime and accepted personal workload remain stable

discovery_outcomes.subject: target_user
discovery_outcomes.target_segment_or_system: the configured technical owner completing matched core tasks in OpenLinear and the approved reference condition
discovery_outcomes.expected_change: complete the matched workflow with near-reference time and interaction cost

metric.name: median reference-relative task-time overhead
metric.definition: median across approved tasks of one hundred times OpenLinear median completion time divided by Linear median completion time minus one hundred
metric.population: the configured owner across repeated task attempts in both matched conditions
metric.workload: eight approved project, milestone, issue, view, and detail tasks

measurement.method: matched-task timing study by the configured owner with fixed viewport, start and end rules, warm-up, repetitions, and interaction-count diagnostic
measurement.source: CT-2 benchmark worksheet and corresponding OpenLinear test-run records

guardrails.name: matched-task error rate
guardrails.metric_definition: share of measured task attempts ending in an unrecovered user or product error

invalidation_threshold.metric_definition: median reference-relative task-time overhead after two bounded interaction revisions

assumptions: matched task definitions remain behaviorally equivalent
approved reference evidence remains admissible after qualified clean-room review

discovery_outcomes.subject: protected_quality
discovery_outcomes.target_segment_or_system: approved clean-room project, milestone, issue-list, and issue-detail fixtures at pinned viewports
discovery_outcomes.expected_change: preserve the reference workflow's structural density and spatial hierarchy with independently designed identity

metric.name: worst-fixture structural screenshot difference
metric.definition: maximum approved-fixture share of comparable unmasked pixels differing beyond the per-pixel tolerance in the pinned environment
metric.workload: one deterministic capture per approved screen and viewport

measurement.method: Playwright screenshot comparison with pinned browser, fonts, viewport, fixture, locale, time, and motion
measurement.source: versioned clean-room visual baselines and CI comparison artifacts

guardrails.name: serious automated accessibility violations
guardrails.metric_definition: count of serious or critical automated accessibility violations on core screens

invalidation_threshold.metric_definition: worst-fixture structural screenshot difference after two bounded visual revisions

assumptions: the pinned rendering environment is reproducible
clean-room masks exclude only branding and documented volatile regions

discovery_outcomes.subject: system
discovery_outcomes.target_segment_or_system: supported one-process local releases using the canonical seeded dataset and SQLite upgrade path
discovery_outcomes.expected_change: preserve all authoritative local records through export, SQLite backup, restore, upgrade, rollback, and compatible import

metric.name: authoritative data round-trip success rate
metric.definition: share of export-import and backup-restore trials whose canonical record and relation digest matches the source
metric.population: supported operating-system, pinned-Node, and schema-version combinations in the release matrix
metric.workload: one canonical export-import and one backup-restore trial per supported combination

measurement.method: canonical export digest comparison across export-import, backup-restore, restart, and accepted upgrade trials
measurement.source: versioned recovery test artifacts and canonical digests

guardrails.name: critical data-loss defect count
guardrails.metric_definition: count of confirmed critical defects that irreversibly lose an authoritative record in a supported operation
guardrails.source: recovery tests and confirmed defect records

invalidation_threshold.metric_definition: authoritative data round-trip success rate on the release candidate

assumptions: canonical serialization covers every authoritative record and relation
supported runtime and schema combinations are frozen before review

discovery_outcomes.subject: protected_quality
discovery_outcomes.target_segment_or_system: complete public source, build output, local runtime artifact, documentation, assets, and release manifest
discovery_outcomes.expected_change: be publishable under an accepted open-source license with distinct identity, complete provenance, and no private reference material

metric.name: mandatory clean-room release audit pass rate
metric.definition: share of mandatory identity, license, attribution, asset provenance, private-evidence exclusion, and reproducible-build checks passing
metric.population: mandatory checks in the accepted public-release audit matrix
metric.workload: one complete audit of the release candidate and its source distribution

measurement.method: manifest, provenance, license, private-evidence, identity, and reproducible-build audit by assigned reviewers
measurement.source: signed release audit matrix and build manifest
measurement.owner: Product owner and qualified release reviewers

guardrails.name: private authenticated reference artifacts in distribution
guardrails.metric_definition: count of private authenticated screenshots, raw workspace records, tokens, or equivalent reference artifacts found in the public distribution
guardrails.source: release privacy scan and provenance audit

invalidation_threshold.metric_definition: mandatory clean-room release audit pass rate at the release decision

assumptions: CT-3 assigns qualified decision owners
the final public name and license are accepted before publication

discovery_outcomes.subject: target_user
discovery_outcomes.expected_change: complete the first useful planning action shortly after Google sign-in

metric.name: ten-minute hosted activation rate
metric.definition: share of eligible first-time owners who complete Google sign-in, workspace bootstrap, project creation, and first issue creation within ten minutes
metric.population: first-time owner accounts with successful Google sign-in and no prior trial eligibility record
metric.workload: one initial hosted workspace bootstrap per eligible owner

guardrails.name: owner bootstrap error rate
guardrails.metric_definition: share of eligible owner bootstrap attempts ending in an unhandled or unrecoverable error
guardrails.source: product event ledger and error telemetry

assumptions: Google sign-in availability is not the dominant failure mode
the provisional observation window follows a usable release

discovery_outcomes.subject: target_user
discovery_outcomes.target_segment_or_system: eligible trial workspaces with at least one sent invitation
discovery_outcomes.expected_change: complete a durable owner-to-member collaboration loop

metric.name: seven-day collaboration-loop completion rate
metric.definition: share of eligible workspaces with one accepted invite, one non-owner action on an assigned issue, and one non-owner comment within seven days of the first invite
metric.population: trial workspaces sending their first valid member invitation
metric.workload: one first invitation and resulting assigned-work loop per workspace

measurement.source: authoritative workspace and product event ledger

guardrails.name: unwanted or duplicate accepted membership rate
guardrails.metric_definition: share of accepted memberships created without one valid intended invitation and matching signed-in email

assumptions: one assignee and two roles cover the first collaboration loop
the provisional observation window follows a usable release

discovery_outcomes.subject: target_user
discovery_outcomes.target_segment_or_system: eligible workspace owners whose 30-day Pro trial ends
discovery_outcomes.expected_change: choose and maintain a paid hosted subscription at the sponsor-confirmed price

metric.name: seven-day trial-to-paid conversion rate
metric.definition: share of eligible workspaces activating a paid monthly or annual subscription within seven days after the 30-day trial ends
metric.population: non-abusive workspaces completing a first 30-day Pro trial during the window
metric.workload: one trial-expiry and subscription decision per eligible workspace

measurement.source: server-owned entitlement ledger and verified Stripe readback

guardrails.name: variable service cost share
guardrails.metric_definition: Firebase, payment processing, and directly attributable hosted variable costs divided by recognized subscription revenue for the cohort
guardrails.source: Firebase billing export and Stripe balance/revenue records

assumptions: USD before applicable taxes is acceptable for launch
one-user Free fallback avoids coercive data loss
the annual discount remains sponsor-approved

discovery_outcomes.subject: system
discovery_outcomes.target_segment_or_system: versioned OpenLinear REST and MCP product-management surfaces
discovery_outcomes.expected_change: complete canonical PM operations correctly and safely through either automation surface

metric.name: canonical automation task success rate
metric.definition: share of canonical project, milestone, issue, assignment, comment, membership, and read-only billing tasks returning the expected durable state through both REST and MCP without manual repair
metric.workload: one deterministic run per task through REST and MCP for owner and member roles

measurement.source: API/MCP structured results, audit ledger, and authoritative Firestore readback

guardrails.name: successful cross-workspace unauthorized operations
guardrails.metric_definition: count of unauthorized cross-workspace reads or mutations that return protected data or change protected state
guardrails.source: cross-workspace security suite and audit ledger

assumptions: scoped personal tokens pass T-SECURITY-MCP
the provisional observation window follows an implementation candidate
